properties.description: Stranger Things (credited as a 2010 production and released June 11, 2013) is a drama directed by Eleanor Burke and Ron Eyal and starring Adeel Akhtar, Vivienne Burke, and Bridget Collins. The film follows a grieving woman who offers shelter in her garden shed to a mysterious homeless man, and through their tentative coexistence an unlikely, touching bond develops. Small, intimate scenes explore themes of grief, loneliness, and the healing power of human connection, rendered in a tender, melancholic tone.

short_descriptions.value: A grieving woman befriends a mysterious homeless man and offers him shelter in her garden shed, forging an unlikely bond that sparks healing.
Eine trauernde Frau freundet sich mit einem geheimnisvollen Obdachlosen an und bietet ihm im Gartenhaus Unterschlupf, wodurch eine heilende Bindung entsteht.
Una mujer en duelo entabla amistad con un vagabundo misterioso y le ofrece cobijo en el cobertizo del jardín, creando un vínculo que impulsa la sanación.
Une femme en deuil se lie d’amitié avec un SDF mystérieux et lui offre un abri dans le cabanon du jardin, créant un lien qui amorce la guérison.

properties.description: Behind the Curtain: Stranger Things - The First Shadow (2025), directed by Jonathan Halperin, is a documentary centered on the making of the stage production Stranger Things: The First Shadow. Featuring Sonia Friedman, Stephen Daldry, and Matt Duffer, it follows the cast and crew as they prepare for a major West End premiere. The film captures the collaboration, pressure, and anticipation surrounding the production while highlighting the creative process behind the scenes.

short_descriptions.value: Backstage access follows the hectic preparation for a major West End theater premiere.
Mit exklusivem Blick hinter die Kulissen begleiten wir die hektischen Vorbereitungen für eine große West-End-Premiere.
Con acceso entre bambalinas, sigue los frenéticos preparativos de un gran estreno teatral en el West End.
Avec un accès exclusif aux coulisses, on suit les préparatifs frénétiques d’une grande première au West End.

properties.description: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5 (2026) is a feature documentary directed by Martina Radwan that chronicles a year on set during the creation of a prominent show's final season. Combining candid interviews, archival clips, and observational set footage, the film reveals the collaborative, technical, and emotional work involved in finishing a long-running narrative. Themes of creative process, teamwork, legacy, and closure run throughout, and the tone balances heartfelt admiration with bittersweet reflection.

short_descriptions.value: A yearlong, behind-the-scenes look at the production of Stranger Things' final season, documenting rehearsals, on-set challenges, and the creative process.
Ein einjähriger Blick hinter die Kulissen der Produktion der finalen Staffel von Stranger Things, mit Proben, Problemen am Set und dem kreativen Prozess.
Una mirada de un año detrás de cámaras al rodaje de la última temporada de Stranger Things, documentando ensayos, retos en el set y el proceso creativo.
Un regard d'un an, en coulisses, sur la production de la dernière saison de Stranger Things, montrant répétitions, aléas de tournage et processus créatif.

properties.description: Poor Things (2023), directed by Yorgos Lanthimos and starring Emma Stone, Mark Ruffalo and Willem Dafoe, is a darkly comic, visually opulent adaptation blending science fiction and period drama. The story follows a woman resurrected by an eccentric scientist who awakens with a childlike intelligence and embarks on a sensual, transgressive journey that exposes questions of personhood, emancipation, and the ethics of creation. The film is notable for extravagant costume and production design, a whimsical yet unsettling aesthetic, and a tone that alternates between wonder and moral provocation.
properties.filming_location: Origo Film Studio, Budapest, Hungary, Hungary, Lisbon, Portugal

short_descriptions.value: A woman resurrected by an eccentric scientist awakens with a childlike mind and sets off on a surreal, sensual journey of self-discovery in a stylized Victorian world.

Eine von einem exzentrischen Wissenschaftler wiederbelebte Frau erwacht mit kindlichem Bewusstsein und begibt sich auf eine sinnliche, surrealistische Reise der Selbstfindung in einer stilisierten viktorianischen Welt.
Una mujer resucitada por un científico excéntrico despierta con mente infantil y emprende un viaje sensorial y surrealista de autodescubrimiento en un mundo victoriano estilizado.
Une femme ressuscitée par un scientifique excentrique s'éveille avec l'esprit d'un enfant et part en voyage sensuel et surréaliste à la découverte d'elle‑même dans un univers victorien stylisé.
